title: Hartree-Fock on a superconducting qubit quantum computer
authors: et al. (Google AI Quantum and Collaborators)
problem_summary: Performs the largest chemical simulation on a quantum computer to date at publication (up to a dozen qubits), including modeling the isomerization mechanism of diazene, using a Givens-rotation-based ansatz variationally optimized to prepare the Hartree-Fock wavefunction.

components.family_or_name: Givens-rotation noninteracting-fermion-evolution ansatz (variationally optimized to prepare the Hartree-Fock state)
components.notes: Classically tractable to simulate yet generates highly entangled computational-basis states.

workflow_composition_notes: Givens-rotation ansatz variationally optimized within a VQE-style loop specifically to reproduce the Hartree-Fock reference state, as a scalable primitive rather than a full correlated-energy calculation.
